parsed.visual_overview: A horizontal split-screen layout. The top half features a 3D animated AI avatar speaking directly to the camera against an abstract background. The bottom half shows a young Indian woman applying oil to her hair in a warmly lit room, interacting with the AI. App UI and pricing overlays occasionally appear in the center.

characters.name: Miss Nova
characters.brief: AI tutor avatar, glossy 3D animated style with a cheerful, encouraging demeanor.

characters.name: Priya
characters.brief: Young Indian woman, casual and relaxed while performing her hair-oiling routine.

scenes.scene_brief: Learner oils her hair while the AI tutor corrects her English.
scenes.supernova_script:
Miss Nova says: What are you doing?
Priya says: I'm adding oil.
Miss Nova says: Actually, it's "I'm applying oil." Or you should say, "I'm oiling my hair." Do you want to learn English?
Priya says: Yes, but I don't have much money.
Miss Nova says: Don't worry about the cost. You can start learning English with an AI teacher on your phone.
Priya says: How?

scenes.scene_brief: App interface overlay appears showing learning paths.
scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Just speak with me daily on Supernova AI. Over 1 crore users are already practicing, and I correct your mistakes live while you speak!

scenes.scene_brief: Learner pauses oiling to ask a question directly to the camera.
scenes.supernova_script:
Priya says: Will it be good?
Miss Nova says: It's much more effective than offline coaching. I analyze your exact level and explain things in your own language, so you'll improve in just 30 days.
Priya says: But won't that cost a lot?

scenes.scene_brief: Pricing overlay appears over the split-screen.
scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: Not at all! Supernova AI is actually about 7 times cheaper than offline classes. Plus, there's zero judgement, so you can make a thousand mistakes and practice anytime.

scenes.scene_brief: Final app store installation prompt overlay.
scenes.supernova_script: Miss Nova says: So click the install button, download Supernova AI right now, and start speaking with me today!
